proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: When the Sokovia Accords split the Avengers, Natasha sides with Tony and Wanda with Steve. At the airport battle, Wanda pins Natasha with her powers and throws her away from Clint.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Natasha's trainee, who sides with Steve and throws her aside at the airport.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Wanda's trainer, who sides with Tony over the Accords.

changes.evidence: Captain America: Civil War: Natasha joins Tony's team and Wanda joins Steve's. At Leipzig/Halle Airport, while Natasha fights Clint, Wanda pins her with telekinesis and throws her away from him. They fight on opposite sides, a clear turn from the trainer and trainee stage of Age of Ultron.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Natasha, Steve and Sam rescue Wanda and Vision from Proxima Midnight and Corvus Glaive in Edinburgh. In Wakanda, Wanda saves Natasha and Okoye from the Threshers, and they step in when Proxima moves to kill her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow fugitive Natasha rescues in Edinburgh, who saves her in Wakanda.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow fugitive who rescues Wanda in Edinburgh, then fights beside her in Wakanda.

changes.evidence: Avengers: Infinity War: Steve, Sam and Natasha arrive in Edinburgh and fight off Proxima Midnight and Corvus Glaive to save Wanda and Vision. In the Battle of Wakanda Wanda stops the Threshers that are about to hit Natasha and Okoye, then Natasha and Okoye fight Proxima when she moves to kill Wanda. They are back on the same side after Civil War.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: Rocket is left on Berhert to guard Nebula, the Guardians' prisoner, but she gets free and joins the Ravager mutiny that locks him up. Later she fights beside him and the Guardians to save Quill from Ego.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian who guards Nebula on Berhert, then fights beside her against Ego.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Guardians' prisoner, who joins the mutiny that locks Rocket up, then fights beside him.

changes.evidence: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2: Ayesha hands Nebula to the Guardians as a prisoner, and Rocket and Groot stay behind on Berhert to repair the ship and watch her. Yondu's Ravagers capture Rocket, and Nebula aids Taserface's mutiny, after which Rocket and Yondu are imprisoned. Rocket later arrives on Ego's planet and, with Nebula and the others, rescues Quill. Their connection starts here, before the Endgame stage.

proposed.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
proposed.text: T'Challa dies of an illness, and Okoye weeps as she helps carry his casket at his funeral.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Okoye's king, whose casket she helps carry when he dies of an illness.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's closest protector, who helps carry his casket at his funeral.

changes.evidence: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever opens with T'Challa dying of an illness Shuri cannot cure. At his funeral Okoye, in tears, helps carry his casket to the Royal Talon Fighter and salutes. A death is a stage under the binding rules.
